description: On desktop, Studio's own main window may read and set Halonic's login item through login_item_get and login_item_set, which Settings › Startup's "Start Halonic when I log in" switch calls (B1 step 6, HAL-14221; D9 of the HAL-14206 design note). login_item_set takes only on or off: the entry is this user's only and its one argument, --background, is fixed in the shell (security review on HAL-14212). No window gets an autostart plugin's own commands, a focused app's window gets none of these, and it is local only, so the Studio the computer serves gets nothing.
